get.summary: List the game rewards the node gives
get.description: Requires the account bearer. Returns rewards [{reward,units}], each reward's Dew in integer millionths.

200.description: The rewards and their Dew; no-store

post.summary: Claim a game reward for the account
post.description: The node sets each reward's Dew; the client names only the reward. Requires synced complete evidence with at least 10 actual moves for every preceding level: Classic 1-28 for the secret chest, 1-175 for campaign completion. Offline play remains available; never-synced or incomplete legacy routes do not grant rewards. Returns {reward,units,credited,balance}; each account is credited once.

200.description: Claimed, or claimed before, with the current balance

403.description: Required qualifying completion evidence has not synced

post.description: Requires the configured X-Daochi-Admin token. Body: {game,source_version,maps:[{level,map_hash,map}]}. Accepts at most 512 maps and 1 MiB. Classic map_hash is SHA256 of shovey.classic.map.v1, LF, decimal level, LF, and the exact lowercase 1440-character cells+tiles+decorations encoding, with no trailing LF. Solutions are excluded. Old revisions remain after map updates or package cleanup. Account clients cannot register maps.

post.summary: Sync one completed attempt for the authenticated account
post.description: Body: {game,level,map_hash,moves,actions,trace,evidence_complete}. Limit 1 MiB, 60000 accepted actions and 120000 visited cells. Actual engine moves are separate from actions and traced cells. Trace uses two lowercase hex digits per cell, includes slide cells and paired portal entrance/exit. Validates the registered exact map, unconditional solids, start/end and adjacency or exact portal pair; does not replay the puzzle engine. Repeated identical submissions are idempotent. Retains all attempts so a sub10 shortest route or incomplete legacy attempt cannot hide qualifying evidence. No per-move requests.

200.description: Stored with id and created flag; private, no-store

get.summary: Read the account's completion history and exact played map
get.description: Requires game, level and map_hash query fields; optional nonnegative offset. Returns completions, map and next_offset, ordered by fewest actual moves, 16 attempts per page. Account bearer required; another account's history is never returned. Incomplete legacy evidence remains non-eligible history.
